name: chttr
author: robjobbed
description: Voice dictation and meeting transcripts for Omarchy. Hold Insert, talk, let go: local Parakeet speech-to-text, cleaned up by Claude, typed into any app. Records meetings (built for Google Meet) with speaker names from captions, your calendar and remembered voices. Click the widget once to set up.

barWidget.description: Dictation and meeting recording status, with a timer while a meeting is recorded. Left click: menu (or start chttr when it's off). Right click: start or stop recording a meeting.

schema.label: Show the meeting timer
schema.description: Show how long the meeting has been recording next to the icon.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: meeting: start or stop recording a meeting. handsfree: start or stop hands-free dictation.
